description: interface.inputs holds several non-string keys (3.14 a float, null, true a bool, 2024-01-01 a date, all read that way by YAML's own implicit resolver): jsonschema's own json_path property assumes every path element is a string or an int and raises TypeError building it, collapsing the whole check to that one exception's text instead of listing every violation; a null key hits a second jsonschema accident, its own descend() treating a None path segment as 'no segment at all' rather than a real one. Each error now renders the key's own text (interface.inputs[3.14].type, interface.inputs[None].type, interface.inputs[True].type, interface.inputs[2024-01-01].type) and the document's other violation (the bad NamePattern) is still listed too.
